public_payload.normalized_proposition: Two new lawsuits were filed against OpenAI in February 2024, one on copyright and one a broader class action.

from_speaker: the other a broader class action
our_interpretation: OpenAI entities must be defendants in two distinct newly filed cases.
A copyright case includes a claim under the Digital Millennium Copyright Act.
A broader class action means a proposed class action alleging privacy, consumer, or other violations beyond copyright. Certification is not required.
Because the introduction says 'some of what's happened,' the ordinary reading identifies two qualifying cases rather than asserting that exactly two cases existed.

criteria.contradiction_condition: The identified cases were not newly filed during the target period, did not name OpenAI defendants, or lacked the stated copyright and broader class-action characteristics.
